scope: User-authorized Ubuntu WSL distro terminate/start and post-start Linux application/PostgreSQL smoke
docker_in_ubuntu_recovery: Docker Desktop user-distro proxy restarted in Ubuntu; Docker API became available without daemon restart
proxy_recovery_mode_at_end: Hidden Windows WSL process running Docker Desktop user-distro proxy for Ubuntu
limitations: Distro lifecycle test, not a Windows host or shared WSL kernel reboot
Post-restart smoke exercised Linux native application and PostgreSQL; n8n/Odoo/Graph were not in that smoke
Docker Desktop integration did not reconnect automatically and required its user-distro proxy to be restarted
A transient Ubuntu systemd unit disappeared when WSL idled; the proxy was relaunched through a hidden Windows WSL process for the current session, not installed as a permanent boot configuration
Application smoke used the previously staged Linux runtime package
